description: This Dart source file implements a Flutter login screen supporting password-based and OTP-based authentication, password reset functionality, and navigation to dashboard and signup screens.

classes.name: LoginScreen
classes.description: A StatefulWidget representing the login screen allowing password and OTP login methods, password reset, and navigation upon successful login.

classes.name: LoginMode
classes.description: An enum to switch between password-based and OTP-based login modes.

methods.name: _loginWithPassword
methods.description: Attempts to authenticate using provided phone/email and password, handles success and failure states, manages failedAttempts counter.

methods.name: _requestOtp
methods.description: Requests an OTP to be sent to the specified phone number, managing loading and error states.

methods.name: _verifyOtpAndLogin
methods.description: Verifies entered OTP, logs user in upon success.

methods.name: _passwordResetRequest
methods.description: Initiates password reset process by requesting OTP for password reset.

methods.name: _passwordResetConfirm
methods.description: Completes password reset with provided OTP and new password.
